requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Ambiguities regarding the trigger condition and nature of rejection were resolved using controlled context (glossary and business rules). The requirement is structured as a single functional requirement based on the supported interpretation: the system raises an alert specifically when a rejection order for a cancellation request is received.

source_fragments: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.

fields.condition: a rejection order is received for a cancellation request

structured_requirements.final_statement: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.
structuring_notes: Resolved ambiguity AMB-01: Rejection order is specific to the cancellation request workflow.
Resolved ambiguity AMB-02: Rejection implies denial of the cancellation request, not rejection of an order to cancel.
Actor inferred as Security Manager based on glossary and BR-01.
